description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of different models or configurations, comparing their performance across two datasets or scenarios, with the categories listed on the horizontal axis and accuracy percentage on the vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)" and ranging from 75.0 to 95.0 in increments of 2.5. The chart is divided into two groups of bars, each representing a different dataset or scenario, with the right-hand group labeled "PolitiFact" in the top-right corner. The categories on the horizontal axis include "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition", with each category having a corresponding bar in both groups, colored in red, orange, yellow, light blue, blue, and dark blue, respectively. The bars in both groups have varying heights, with the red "Ours" bars being the tallest at 89.84 and 90.57, and the yellow "w/o text" bars being the shortest at 80.10 and 83.02, while the other bars have intermediate values, such as 86.82 and 85.85 for "w/o comments", 88.80 and 89.62 for "w/o select", 87.34 and 84.91 for "w/o emotion", and 87.17 and 87.74 for "w/o cognition". The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
